title: Can parts be collected separately after oil quenching on a mesh-belt furnace line?
summary: Suneng's 2020 roller-supported mesh-belt heat-treatment line proposal places a rotatable discharge hopper at the oil-tank elevator exit for side discharge of workpieces whose process does not require tempering on this line. The normal route continues into the tempering furnace. This provides alternative receiving paths; hopper rotation does not establish that a material may omit tempering or has completed all heat treatment.
